definitions.label: Cash conversion
definitions.question: Does reported profit turn into operating cash?
definitions.formula: sum(operating_cash_flow[2023..2025]) / sum(earnings[2023..2025]); requires all inputs and positive earnings sum

definitions.label: FCF yield
definitions.question: What is free cash flow relative to the current market cap?

definitions.label: ROIC
definitions.question: What does the business earn on the capital it uses?
definitions.formula: ebit[2025] × (1 − t) / (total_debt[2025] + total_equity[2025] − cash_and_equivalents[2025]); t = tax[2025] / earnings_before_tax[2025] when EBT > 0 and 0 ≤ t ≤ 1, otherwise t = 0.22 (Indonesian statutory fallback); requires positive invested capital

definitions.label: ROE
definitions.question: What does it earn on shareholders' equity?

definitions.label: Interest coverage
definitions.question: How many times does operating profit cover interest?

definitions.label: Net debt / EBITDA
definitions.question: How many years of EBITDA would repay net debt?

definitions.label: Current ratio
definitions.question: Do short-term assets cover short-term obligations?

definitions.label: Reinvestment rate
definitions.question: How much operating cash goes back into capex?
definitions.formula: sum(|capital_expenditure[2023..2025]|) / sum(operating_cash_flow[2023..2025]); capex is an outflow reported with either sign (the provider's free_cash_flow equals CFO − |capex| either way), so its absolute value is used; requires all inputs and positive CFO sum

definitions.label: Share dilution
definitions.question: How much has the share count changed in five years?

definitions.label: Revenue CAGR
definitions.question: How fast has revenue compounded over five years?

definitions.label: P/E / history
definitions.question: Is today's P/E above or below its own history?
definitions.formula: pe_ttm / median(positive pe[2020..2025]); requires positive pe_ttm and at least 3 positive reported years; TTM = Q3-2025..Q2-2026

definitions.label: P/B / history
definitions.question: Is today's P/B above or below its own history?
definitions.formula: pb_mrq / median(positive pb[2020..2025]); requires positive pb_mrq and at least 3 positive reported years

definitions.label: Dividend years
definitions.question: In how many of the last six years was a dividend reported?
definitions.formula: count(total_dividend[2020..2025] > 0); a null year counts as not reported, not as a reported zero dividend

definitions.label: Free float
definitions.question: How much of the company trades freely?

definitions.label: Largest holder
definitions.question: How much does the largest single holder own?
definitions.formula: max(percentage among holdings with holderKind = entity); excludes public and treasury; requires every entity percentage

definitions.label: NPL ratio
definitions.question: What share of loans is non-performing?

definitions.label: Loan / deposit
definitions.question: How fully are deposits lent out?

definitions.label: Capital adequacy
definitions.question: How much capital backs risk-weighted assets?

definitions.label: Net interest margin
definitions.question: What spread does the bank earn on its assets?
